purpose: promote the previously sampled conflict-control landmark feasibility check to exact full-rate decoded-frame candidate-geometry coverage and, only if coverage is complete, deterministic adjacent-frame ear-motion triage

backend.mode: CatDetectionMode.faceOnly on two preregistered fixed spatial ROIs

duplicate_face_guard.metric: distance between returned face-box centers divided by full-frame diagonal

frame_classification.PASS_DISTINCT_ROI_CANDIDATES: both ROI channels return exactly one structurally valid 48-point face and the two returned face centers pass the preregistered spatial-distinctness guard
frame_classification.REVIEW_DUPLICATE_FACE_RISK: both ROI channels return structurally valid faces but spatial distinctness is below the preregistered guard
frame_classification.INCOMPLETE_ROI_FACE_CHANNELS: one or both ROI channels fail to return exactly one structurally valid 48-point face

adjacent_ear_motion_triage.algorithm: existing face-aligned non-ear similarity-removal triage in scripts/build_ear_motion_triage.py
adjacent_ear_motion_triage.derivation: (1218-1) adjacent decoded-frame transitions times two candidate cats

artifact_requirements: ear-motion triage or explicit blocked receipt
claim_ceiling: The full-rate conflict-control gate may establish exact decoded-frame candidate coverage, pinned 48-landmark structure and deterministic ear-motion triage feasibility for the non-affiliative control. It cannot establish landmark accuracy, independent subject identity, CatFACS EAD103/EAD104, action onset, mimicry, delta-t, feline response latency or INDEPENDENT_FRAME_LEVEL_ESTIMATE.
